report.question_or_target: Across Argo Workflows, Temporal, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, AWS Step Functions and GitHub Actions: which DSL features (typed params, conditionals, sub-workflows, matrix expansion, artifacts, retries, timeouts, manual approval) are present in each, and which subset is strictly necessary to express our required blueprint categories without escaping to arbitrary code?
report.answer_summary: The 7x8 presence matrix is established from 34 live-archived official sources (lineage ok=34/34). The strictly necessary subset for the six required library categories is typed-params, conditionals, matrix-expansion (as bounded data-driven fanout), artifacts, timeouts, and manual-approval. Sub-workflows and retries are not strictly necessary: they have constructive inlining and unrolling controls. The 96-card identity census is NOT-CHECKED because platform/workflows is absent here.
report.strict_necessity_rule: Necessary means at least one required category has runtime-varying semantics that cannot be represented by a finite unconditional graph and scalar task values without delegating control, validation, durability, time, or authority to arbitrary code/an undeclared external convention. Reuse and compactness alone do not qualify.
